QuestInfo.name: [Detective Rave's Case Notes] The Crash Site
QuestInfo.0:
The situation started to unravel with the appearance of a girl named Senya. Now you have to look for the cargo she was transporting. 

Talk to #bLuxury Tour Agency Staff#k in #bBrigand's Row#k.
QuestInfo.1: If you don't want Senya to get hurt, you need to get to #bSeedy Scrapyard 1#k fast and take a look at the wreck.
QuestInfo.2: You found the crashed ship in #bSeedy Scrapyard 1#k. While you were surrounded by Hooligans, someone called #bDetective Rave#k made a fancy entry.
